purpose: Compute next main-jet stamp from a stopwatch-proven baseline and a new RAD reading.
confirm: Jet stamps and class needles change. Confirm current regs before racing the result.

rad_standard.note: RAD is density vs this ISA-like reference, as percent.

jet_stamp.karting_convention: stamp ≈ hole diameter in 0.01 mm. Stamp 60 ≈ 0.60 mm, stamp 126 ≈ 1.26 mm.
jet_stamp.flow_vs_hole: Reliable makers flow-test then stamp. A 96 may measure 0.94–0.98 mm and still flow as a 96. Do not resize by hole measurement alone.

power_af.note: EGT is a comparison to a dyno/WOT baseline, not a target by itself.
